title: MOKA: a pipeline for multiomics bridged SNP-set kernel association test.
authors: Enoma, David; Wang, Dinghao; Kamdoum, Ariel Ghislain Kemogne; Polo, Rodrigo Ortega; Long, Quan; He, Jingni
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍MOKA流程，将多组学数据（含转录因子结合）整合进SNP-set关联检验，虽涉及TF-DNA注释但非核心互作建模，方法为统计关联而非AI/物理模拟，故为中档相关。
abstract: The explosion of genomic and multiomics data has created a need for scalable, reproducible tools that integrate functional annotations into genome-wide association studies (GWAS). We introduce the multiomics data bridged Kernel Association test (MOKA) pipeline, a Snakemake-based workflow that automates SNP-set kernel-based association testing by incorporating multiomics data, including gene expression, transcription factor binding, evolutionary conservation scores, and neural network-derived features. This data-bridged architecture enhances variant prioritization and aggregation, improving statistical power in GWAS. MOKA supports population structure correction via spectral decomposition, parallel computation, and post-GWAS analyses, including visualization, Gene Ontology annotation, pathway enrichment, and validation. As a use case, we applied MOKA to a schizophrenia GWAS cohort, identified 89 Bonferroni-significant genes, with a 15.7% validation rate in the disease-specific DisGeNET database and enrichment in pathways relevant to neuropsychiatric disease. MOKA provides a robust, scalable, and extensible framework for functional multiomics integration in genetic studies. It is open-source and available at https://github.com/davidenoma/moka.
abstract_zh: 基因组和多组学数据的爆炸式增长，催生了对可扩展、可复现工具的需求，这些工具能将功能注释整合到全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中。我们引入了多组学数据桥接核关联检验（MOKA）流程，这是一个基于Snakemake的工作流，通过整合多组学数据（包括基因表达、转录因子结合、进化保守性评分和神经网络衍生特征）自动化进行SNP集核关联检验。这种数据桥接架构增强了变异优先级排序和聚合，提升了GWAS中的统计功效。MOKA支持通过谱分解进行群体结构校正、并行计算以及GWAS后分析，包括可视化、基因本体注释、通路富集和验证。作为应用案例，我们将MOKA应用于精神分裂症GWAS队列，识别出89个Bonferroni显著基因，在疾病特异性DisGeNET数据库中验证率为15.7%，并富集于与神经精神疾病相关的通路。MOKA为遗传研究中的功能多组学整合提供了一个稳健、可扩展且可扩展的框架。它是开源的，可在https://github.com/davidenoma/moka获取。
